figureAlts.figure11.gif: You are playing a wheel-spinning game at a carnival, where you can earn prizes based on where the wheel stops. The booth attendant claims the distribution of prizes is as shown in the table, but you think the game is rigged and doesn’t follow the listed probabilities. You would like to test your claim so you can report the carnival for fraud. The table has columns Prize and Chance. Row 1: Nothing, 80%; Row 2: Teddy bear, 2%; Row 3: Pinwheel, 6%; Row 4: Sticker, 12%.
